reelection.rule: Rule: next even-year November for this House term. legislators-current.yaml ends the current term on 2027-01-03. The even-year November before that January 3 end is November 2026. The file has no election day, so no day of the month is shown.

I would like to give a special thanks to all of the military academy representatives who gave presentations: 
🇺🇲 2nd Lt. Joseph Stellmach, U.S. Air Force Academy 
🇺🇲 Lt. Col. (Ret.) Dan Freedman, Air National Guard, representing the U.S. Naval Academy
🇺🇲 David Kraemer, U.S. Army and Field Force, representing West Point
🇺🇲 Cmdr. Keith Watson, Assistant Director of Admissions, U.S. Merchant Marine Academy

I would also like to acknowledge some of our incredible Military Academy Nomination Panelists for the Central Coast: Dr. Paul Webber, Dr. Steve Sabo, and Dr. James Bailey. Thank you for the time you give to help our next generation of leaders.

Trump's Big Ugly Bill has been a disaster for Central Coast families, especially those who lost their health coverage because of the bill’s impact on Medicaid and the Affordable Care Act.

I’m fighting to reverse this terrible policy and improve access to affordable health care. https://t.co/0qgZMIBlr0

Thank you Pilot Lt. Miyako Miller, Coast Guard rescue swimmer Josh Law, and the entire Coast Guard Air Station Ventura crew for swiftly responding to the distress call and rescuing 16 people from the open ocean. Your bravery, skills, and dedication to saving lives made all the

"I don't give a damn. We’re making a freaking fortune." 

That is Trump's message to families struggling with higher gas prices. https://t.co/IVzzZ47nZR

I'm deeply disturbed to learn of yet another ICE detainment in Santa Maria — this time, ICE agents violently detained a student with disabilities while they were walking to school. The student is a U.S. citizen and sustained injuries severe enough that they needed surgery. This is outrageous and we should not tolerate these tactics. 

Our schools must remain safe places for students and families, free from fear, intimidation, and racial profiling. 

As we see an increase in ICE's presence across the Central Coast, it is important you know your constitutional rights. See my Know Your Rights page to learn more: https://t.co/zXNW963Mn9

https://t.co/XWhmWpp2zd

The Trump administration's cuts to food assistance, high gas prices from the Iran war, and inflation from tariffs are pushing more Central Coast families to rely on food banks. 

I'm fighting to reverse these bad policies while strengthening federal programs like SNAP to help

Proud to have earned a perfect score on the Human Rights Campaign’s 119th Congressional Scorecard. I will always stand with the LGBTQ+ community, and will continue to fight back against any attempt to undermine the progress we’ve made. @HRC 

https://t.co/oOnbhJFuT8 https://t.co/ZXI7HMH05b

posts.text:
Americans should not have to choose between buying groceries and keeping their homes warm this winter. 

With energy prices soaring due to Trump's illegal war in Iran, I'm joining a bipartisan effort to push Congress to deliver more assistance to families struggling with higher https://t.co/jAHe6bFCTa
Gas prices are up 40% from last year in Santa Maria alone. Enough is enough. I'm pushing to end Trump's illegal war in Iran and bring down prices at the pump. https://t.co/0YVYDHX7zC

I had a great time visiting Ms. Patricia's students at Sheridan Way Elementary school! 

Every election is a chance for people to speak up about issues that impact their everyday lives, and it's never too early to start learning how that works. These students are our future, and I loved hearing their questions and ideas. Thank you for having me!

Many Central Coast residents are concerned about the recent rise in ICE activity. 

To get answers and demand accountability, I went to the Santa Maria ICE facility. Here’s what happened. https://t.co/Y0g0xrhCfI

I toured the Vitalant processing center with Executive Director Susan Noone and her team to learn how blood donation and collection works. Their services support more than 26 Central Coast hospitals — made possible by the generosity of local blood donors. 

I'll keep fighting for our healthcare system and the hardworking people who keep it running.

I joined Santa Barbara County Supervisor Roy Lee and retired Santa Barbara City Fire Chief Pat McElroy for a hike in the Los Padres National Forest to talk about the need to protect our public lands. 

I'm fighting in Congress to protect spaces like Los Padres so that every Central Coast resident has access to beautiful wilderness areas.
On Indigenous Peoples' Day, we honor and celebrate the history, contributions, and culture of the communities that have called the Americas home for thousands of years. https://t.co/3ZFcmdU3bd

Turning a military execution into a public spectacle is deeply disturbing and raises serious questions about the judgment and restraint expected of our nation’s military leadership. 

Hegseth needs to go. https://t.co/BnOJIOGGZN

En los últimos días, hemos visto un aumento en la actividad de ICE en nuestras comunidades. Estoy totalmente en contra de que detengan a nuestros vecinos sin una razón legal y sin una orden judicial. Todas las personas, sin importar su estatus migratorio, tienen derecho al debido proceso y a las protecciones constitucionales.

A medida que vemos más actividad presente de ICE en nuestras comunidades, es importante conocer tus derechos constitucionales. Consulta mi página de recursos Conoce tus Derechos para más información: https://t.co/zXNW963Mn9

Over the past few days, we’ve seen an increase in ICE activity across the Central Coast. I unequivocally condemn the unlawful detention and warrantless arrests of our neighbors. Everyone, regardless of immigration status, is entitled to due process and constitutional protections. 
 
As we see an increase in their presence across our communities, it is important to know your constitutional rights. See my Know Your Rights resource page for more: https://t.co/zXNW963Mn9

As vote by mail ballots begin arriving this week, I wanted to take a moment to remind our community that mail-in voting is safe and secure. California has standards and procedures in place to ensure your vote is safe, private, and protected. 

Remember, your vote is your voice. 

To track your mail-in ballot visit: https://t.co/VZT7edntts

Today marks three years since Hamas' horrific attack on Israeli civilians, communities, and families. My heart is with the loved ones of the 1,200 people who lost their lives that day, and the many hostages who later died in captivity. 

As we honor the lives lost on this day, it is crucial to recognize the disproportionate response of Netanyahu's government and the subsequent devastation and loss of life faced by Palestinian people in Gaza and the West Bank. Tens of thousands of Palestinians — including over 20,000 children — have died as a result of this war, and it is beyond time for the U.S. to work with our allies and partners to implement a lasting ceasefire. 

I am committed to an outcome in which both Israelis and Palestinians are free and secure. We must build a future that guarantees lasting peace in the region.

One of my first jobs was with Head Start where I saw firsthand how impactful these programs were in the lives of students, families, and entire communities. 

Across the Central Coast, these programs provide low-income students and families with the support they need — through educational, health, nutrition, and family support services. 

The Administration wants to strip these programs of funding and critical services. From the start, we have known the President's priorities are out of wack — coming after children and families in need is just plain wrong. 

Public comment for this proposed plan ends today. Make you voice heard here: https://t.co/P1Z839WJEb

https://t.co/sqwL0Qbdar
For a sitting U.S. president to openly invite a foreign adversary to attack our nation is heinous and further evidence of Trump's mental decline. https://t.co/m4v2nUpAxL

I am appalled by ICE’s activities at Allan Hancock College today. College campuses and schools must remain safe places where students, faculty, and families can be free from fear and intimidation. I will be working to uncover exactly what transpired during this operation and will demand full accountability to keep ICE’s brutal and disruptive tactics off our campuses. I stand with the Allan Hancock College community and everyone who has been impacted by ICE’s terrorizing raids.

Hey Central Coast, my office is accepting Military Academy Applications until Wednesday, October 7th! Each year, it is an honor to nominate 10 outstanding individuals from our community to attend one of our nation's service academies. These applications are an important investment in our future and empower the next generation of leaders dedicated to serving our nation. 

For more information on Military Academy Nominations, please visit https://t.co/IqM6wBAJs7

Californians have been clear: no oil drilling on our public lands.

Despite this, the Administration is moving forward with a December sale of approximately 35,000 acres of lands, including some in SLO County. This is another move to help Big Oil at our expense. I remain strongly opposed to these lease sales and will be working with local and state partners to push back. 

Through November 2nd, there is a 30-day period for the public to formally object to this sale, and I encourage anyone who is passionate about this issue to speak up: 

https://t.co/hv3ForNIIi

The President took taxpayer money meant to fight drug trafficking, strengthen border security, and honor fallen law enforcement — and instead spent it on campaign ads.

This administration's corruption has no ceiling. https://t.co/xYwYUhJKzT

The San Pedro Basin has long been the site of an underwater toxic waste dump. I was proud to partner with @SenAlexPadilla on this bill to confront DDT contamination off our coast. 

Read more about it here: https://t.co/pY84nWsAj1 https://t.co/2CCh3mVBLp
Even Trump's AI chatbot knows the truth about his disastrous One Big Ugly Bill. Thanks, https://t.co/Azfjv5YvVL! https://t.co/nvmLBKoUnd

An incompetent move by an incompetent Secretary of Defense. 

In what world does cutting experienced leaders from the Pentagon benefit our military preparedness, national security, or the chain of command? https://t.co/z9nH5AcE9z

Hey Ojai, I'll be hosting a town hall this Thursday from 5:30-6:30 PM in Kent Hall at the Ojai City Hall. I hope you'll join the conversation.

Learn more and register for your spot here: https://t.co/RR6y2zUhB2 https://t.co/rRH4ntDTvg

63 days. 63 opportunities to vote on issues the Central Coast cares about. 63 excuses by House Republicans. 

The people deserve an active and productive House, clearly Speaker Mike Johnson thinks otherwise. https://t.co/o4idBlOwZG

Gun violence impacts our nation every day, and I stand with Moms Demand Action to combat this crisis through practical legislation and safe storage practices. I’ll keep fighting for common-sense solutions that keep our communities safe. https://t.co/ajqXU4oGub

On the Central Coast, we know what wind energy can deliver: quality jobs, local manufacturing growth, and energy security. Despite these benefits, the Trump administration is using taxpayer dollars to incentivize companies to cancel wind projects in favor of fossil fuels. We cannot afford to move backwards.

Proud to stand with my colleagues & the Sierra Club to say YES to wind and NO to dirty deals!

My office is monitoring the ongoing wildfire situation near Cuesta Grade in SLO County. If you are in a neighboring community or traveling on Hwy 101, visit https://t.co/PuH0srcnXr for updates and additional information on current evacuation orders.

https://t.co/10WdZjgNpL

roll_calls.plain_language: H.R. 9237 (Take Care of America’s Veterans Act) addresses veterans’ benefits, health care, counseling, Department of Veterans Affairs personnel, VA infrastructure, and the Veterans Community Care Program.
